title: RUNSTATE.json - long-horizon resume checkpoint (v6.0)
description: Lives at {problem_id}/.sciforge/RUNSTATE.json (NOT inside .sciforge/verdicts/ — it is runtime state, not a judgment). Rewritten by the orchestrator at every phase boundary and at forced human checkpoints. The resume contract in output-protocol.md §Long-Horizon Resume Contract consumes it: a new orchestrator session finding status != completed verifies the verdict trail and resumes from next_action. Validated by the resume protocol (and by tests/test_e2e_smoke.py), not by validate_verdicts.py.

run_id.description: Unique identifier of this pipeline run (same run_id as RUN_BUDGET.json).

problem_id.description: The frozen Q-id / problem slug of the workspace this state belongs to.

current_phase.description: Phase identifier the run is currently at or has just completed (string because of sub-phases: '0', '1b', '2.5', '6b', '15.5', '16').

last_completed_boundary.description: Phase identifier of the last boundary that passed all checks (verdict validation + budget booking). Resume restarts AFTER this boundary.

next_action.description: Human-readable next step for the resuming session (e.g. 'dispatch Phase 6c full experiment', 'await human KILL confirmation', 'enter Phase 12 paper-writing').

status.description: running = mid-phase; paused_checkpoint = awaiting a human approval; paused_blocked = BLOCKED verdict, human decision needed; completed = terminal success; killed = terminated by KILL with no restart.

pending_human_approvals.description: Checkpoint identifiers the run is blocked on (e.g. 'phase5-method-lock', 'kill-checkpoint-L9'); empty unless status == paused_checkpoint.

budget_snapshot.description: Mirror of the decisive RUN_BUDGET.json fields at checkpoint time, so a resuming session can sanity-check the ledger without re-deriving it.
